title: parodia buenekeri var. intermedia

This plant is known for its vibrant, large, and globular stems, which can grow up to 30 cm in diameter, making it a sought-after specimen among cactus collectors. The health benefits of Parodia buenekeri var. intermedia include its ability to promote digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate stress, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of stimulating digestion, reducing anxiety, and promoting relaxation.
